Published as litert-community/LFM3-Audio-2B-LiteRT (upload commit 976325ac, main 32c07192; anonymous Hub read 2026-10-30T21:51:09+09:00, each LFS oid and size = artifact_sha256). Runner rows (Galaxy S26 RFGL80R6A6H): the C-API runner, one process per run, the graph alone with the fixtures (runs r5b n5, r6b h1 / h2, r7 h7). The repo's speech path runs these graphs in the app's loop (the app rows on 2.3.0 / 2026-10-29). The Mac timing rows and the Pixel 8a text decode on the card ran earlier builds with the same decoder bytes that were not published, so they have no record.
